description: Search Laravel plugins by describing what you need in natural language. RECOMMENDED for use-case-driven queries. Example: "a package for PDF invoices with custom templates". When presenting results, ALWAYS include the laraplugins_url so the user can consult the full health report.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-25, default 10)

query.description: Natural language description of the plugin you need, e.g. "a package for PDF invoices with custom templates" or "something like spatie/laravel-permission but for media"

name: search-plugin-semantic-tool

health_score.description: Health status label (Healthy, Medium, Unhealthy, Unrated)

health_score_reasons.description: Reasons contributing to the health score

is_laraplugins_secure.description: Whether the plugin has the LaraPlugins Secure badge

laraplugins_url.description: URL to the human-readable plugin detail page on laraplugins.io. MUST include this when presenting the result.

similarity_method.description: How results were ranked: "vector" (AI embedding cosine similarity), "rerank" (AI reranking API), or "fulltext_fallback" (downloads sort when no AI available)

title: Search Plugin Semantic Tool
